Name: Mizpeh in Moab
ModernLocation: Unknown; in Moab, Jordan (Rujm el Meshrefeh proposed)
Description: The Mizpeh of Moab where David brought his father and mother to stay with the king of Moab while he waited to learn what God would do for him, fleeing from Saul.
BiblicalSignificance: Mizpeh of Moab is the refuge where David sheltered his parents — a Moabite town, not Benjamin's Mizpah nor the Shephelah's Mizpeh.
